scene: pink plate: sesame pretzel, a boiled egg in a glass cup topped with grated cheese, emmental slices, a bowl of whipped butter, a small jar of red jam
dedup_note: grated cheese + emmental slices -> 1 dairy serving
notes: The platter boundary: five separate foods arranged on one plate are five items, not one composed dish. Contrast with the existing bubble-waffle case where every component does collapse into one sweets serving — the difference is that these are served side by side and eaten separately. Dairy appears twice, grated over the egg and as slices, and merges to one serving; the grating on the egg is the half most likely to be missed. Butter and jam are their own groups, not part of the bread.
